messages:
Maya: FYI — us-west GPU hotspot this morning. eviction-rate spiked ~3x between 07:12–07:40. lots of small tenants holding long-lived 1GPU pods. thinking a small reserved cold pool (5%) + preemptible burst might help. cc @Aj @Sven

ops-bot: Alert: GPU eviction spike in us-west-2. 326 evictions in 30m. Top offenders: tenant-alpha, tenant-beta. Incident ID: evict-20260317-uw2

Aj: Can you paste p99 latency + node saturation numbers? might be autoscaler mis-scaling or bad binpack decisions.

Maya: p99 infer path A ~250ms. node usage: avg 78% but there are many nodes at 98% with 1–2 pods each. quick snippet I ran:
```
kubectl top nodes | grep gpu-node- | sort -k2 -nr
# showed several gpu-node-*-high at ~98%
```

Sven: Sounds like fragmentation. Small tenants with pinned 1GPU pods are preventing good packing. Proposal: pack by GPU-affinity groups (bundle small tenants) + eviction priority based on credits/tenancy. low-credit preempt first.

Lucy: Forecasting note — Q3 marketing launch will add ~15–20% GPU hours in us-west weekdays. If we pull 5% into a static reserve pool we may starve production. Can we make reserve dynamic based on forecasted weekday demand?

Diego: Agree with dynamic reserve. Also consider a soft-eviction window (e.g., 06:00–10:00 local) where we prefer not to evict high-SLA jobs. And create an ephemeral preemptible pool for burst that has explicit retry behavior.

Aj: Preemptible bursts are fine but they add tail latency on retries. Need client-side hedging + exponential backoff. We should add a 'preemptible' hint in the SDK so teams can opt in.

Maya: Also want a fragmentation metric exposed: percent GPU capacity wasted due to poor packing (e.g., nodes at low utilization because of misaligned pod sizes). Last week we recorded ~14% fragmentation — I estimate better packing could drop that ~7%.

Sven: I'll run a sim over the last 30 days of placement traces: compare current scheduler vs best-fit-with-coalescing (bundle small pods from different tenants onto shared nodes) and a low-credit eviction policy.

Lucy: If you run that sim include: cost delta ($ saved), p95/p99 latency impact, and eviction counts. Ops: can you provide eviction logs + placement map for the simulation? @ops-bot

ops-bot: Logs export kicked off to internal warehouse: /mnt/warehouse/gpu-evictions/2026-03-17/*.parquet. Filtered export ETA ~2h. Query ID: export-evict-1836

Maya: Plan: Sven runs sim and posts results, Aj prototypes SDK 'preemptible' flag + retry guidance, Diego drafts dynamic reserve policy (ties to forecast), Lucy plugs Q3 numbers into the model. Check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT. :thumbsup:

Aj: sgtm
